governing_policy: Every identity-preserving transformation must preserve a precisely stated structural invariant. Destructive perturbations are strictly segregated into the counterfactual registry.

transformations.name: Global Pitch Transposition
transformations.preserved_structural_invariant: Preserves exact melodic contour, successive voice-leading pitch intervals, rhythmic ratios, harmonic function relations, and relative voice spacing.
transformations.deterministic_implementation: Transpose all note pitches in the source segment by delta semitones while updating SpelledPitch letter and alteration deterministically.
transformations.randomness_policy: Sample interval from parameter_domain using RandomContext stream 'transform.transposition'.
invalidity_conditions: Transposition shifts any note outside standard 88-key piano compass (MIDI 21 to 108).

transformations.name: Octave / Register Displacement
transformations.preserved_structural_invariant: Preserves pitch-class profile, rhythmic duration structure, metric placement, and harmonic root identity under octave equivalence.
transformations.deterministic_implementation: Shift octave field of SpelledPitch by delta octaves (+/-12 semitones per octave).
transformations.randomness_policy: Sample octave_shift and target_voice using RandomContext stream 'transform.octave_displacement'.
invalidity_conditions: Displacement shifts any note outside 88-key piano compass (MIDI 21 to 108).
Displacement causes voice crossing inversion when target_voice is single voice.

transformations.name: Global Rhythmic Augmentation
transformations.preserved_structural_invariant: Preserves relative proportional duration ratios (IOI ratios) and pitch sequence identically, scaling metric tempo uniformly.
transformations.deterministic_implementation: Multiply all note and rest durations and measure relative offsets by scaling_factor.
invalidity_conditions: Total duration exceeds maximum segment boundary limit.

transformations.name: Global Rhythmic Diminution
transformations.preserved_structural_invariant: Preserves relative proportional duration ratios (IOI ratios) and pitch sequence identically at doubled tempo.
transformations.deterministic_implementation: Multiply all note and rest durations and measure relative offsets by Fraction(1, 2).
invalidity_conditions: Resulting duration is shorter than minimum allowed event resolution (1/64 note).

transformations.name: Controlled Diatonic Neighbor Ornament Insertion
transformations.preserved_structural_invariant: Preserves harmonic skeleton, metric downbeat arrival pitches, structural voice leading, and global phrase contour.
transformations.deterministic_implementation: Split selected long notes (> quarter note on unaccented beat) into main note plus diatonic neighbor note sharing total duration.
transformations.randomness_policy: Select eligible events and neighbor direction using RandomContext stream 'transform.ornament_insertion'.
invalidity_conditions: Modification applied to strong downbeat notes or final cadential arrival event.

transformations.name: Controlled Surface Ornament Deletion
transformations.preserved_structural_invariant: Preserves structural pitch skeleton, harmonic progression, and metric pulse while pruning ornamental surface figuration.
transformations.deterministic_implementation: Remove unaccented grace notes or passing tones, absorbing their duration into preceding or succeeding structural notes.
transformations.randomness_policy: Select target ornaments using RandomContext stream 'transform.ornament_deletion'.
invalidity_conditions: Attempting to delete a structural harmonic downbeat pitch.

transformations.name: Voice-Preserving Accompaniment Texture Variation
transformations.preserved_structural_invariant: Preserves primary melodic line in Staff 1, harmonic pitch-class content, bass line progression, and meter.
transformations.deterministic_implementation: Restructure accompaniment figurations in Staff 2 while strictly holding identical harmonic pitch-class multiset per measure.
transformations.randomness_policy: Select accompaniment bars using RandomContext stream 'transform.accompaniment_variation'.
invalidity_conditions: Primary melodic voice in Staff 1 is altered.
